title: Shaar Hayichud chapter (v1)
description: One chapter file (chapter_NN.json) as saved by section-tool: a TextNode[] tree. Lines of text and child nodes are interleaved in document order.

textNode.description: A section. Sections have no persisted id; alignments and transcripts point at lines.

children.description: Lines and sub-sections in document order.

translation.description: Optional English translation of this section's text.

line.description: One line of Hebrew text with a stable id. The id is unique across every chapter, never reused, and survives edits to the line's text, so alignments and transcripts can reference it on its own.

id.description: Stable line id: 8 random lowercase base32 characters, unique across the whole corpus.

text.description: The line's text. Never empty and never contains a newline.
